verses.gurmukhi: ਕਿੰਚਤ ਕਟਾਛ ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹੇ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੰਡ ਖੰਡ ਸਾਧ ਸੰਗ ਰੰਗ ਮੈ ਬਿਮੋਹਿਤ ਮਗਨ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: ki(n)chat kaTaachh maiaa mohe brahama(n)dd kha(n)dd saadh sa(n)g ra(n)g mai bimohit magan hai ||

en.bdb: The Lord whose one transverse glance can infatuate millions of people of the regions and realms in maya, that God, enamoured by the love of the assembly of true God-loving meditating people remains absorbed in them.

verses.gurmukhi: ਜਾਂ ਕੇ ਓਅੰਕਾਰ ਕੈ ਅਕਾਰ ਹੈ ਨਾਨਾ ਪ੍ਰਕਾਰ ਕੀਰਤਨ ਸਮੈ ਸਾਧ ਸੰਗਿ ਸੌ ਲਗਨ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: jaa(n) ke oa(n)kaar kai akaar hai naanaa prakaar keeratan samai saadh sa(n)g sau lagan hai ||

en.bdb: The Lord whose expanse and forms are indescribable, He remains involved in the pious people through the singing of His hymns of praise.

verses.gurmukhi: ਸਿਵ ਸਨਕਾਦਿ ਬ੍ਰਹਮਾਦਿ ਆਗਿਆਕਾਰੀ ਜਾ ਕੇ ਅਗ੍ਰਭਾਗ ਸਾਧ ਸੰਗਿ ਗੁਨਨੁ ਅਗਨ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: siv sanakaadh brahamaadh aagiaakaaree jaa ke agrabhaag saadh sa(n)g gunan agan hai ||

en.bdb: The Lord who has the services of all the three deities and the four sons of Brahma at His beck and call and obedience, that Lord of countless traits remains obedient in the company of the holy and saintly persons who are ever engrossed in Him.

verses.gurmukhi: ਅਗਮ ਅਪਾਰ ਸਾਧ ਮਹਿਮਾ ਅਪਾਰ ਬਿਖੈ ਅਤਿ ਲਿਵਲੀਨ ਜਲ ਮੀਨ ਅਭਗਨ ਹੈ ॥੩੦੨॥
verses.translit_en: agam apaar saadh mahimaa apaar bikhai at livaleen jal meen abhagan hai ||302||

en.bdb: Praise of congregation immersed in His loving remembrance is beyond comprehension. A Guru-conscious devotee remains in love with Him like a fish in water. (302)
